pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark regions with softened vertices and moderately smooth edge gradients; spatial area of patches is largest on the upper torso and neck base, decreasing towards the posterior.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-toned lattice with distinct triple-junction nodes; pathways maintain a relatively uniform pixel thickness across the mid-section of the torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serration along the mane of the neck, forming a jagged 1D contour against the background.
